# SoloHer

> AI-powered travel confidence guides for solo women travelers. Privacy-first, no account required.

## Pages

- [/](/): Plan a trip — enter a destination and get a personalized safety and confidence guide.
- [/guide](/guide): View your AI-generated travel guide with safety insights, practical tips, and offline save options.
- [/saved](/saved): Access your saved guides for offline reading, even without an internet connection.
- [/faq](/faq): Common questions about solo female travel safety and how SoloHer helps.
